arxiv-2109-08147.description: Abstract We use Hubble Space Telescope WFC3 G102 and G141 grism spectroscopy to measure rest-optical emission-line ratios of 533 galaxies at z ∼ 1.5 z\sim 1.5 in the CANDELS Ly α \alpha Emission at Reionization (CLEAR) survey. We compare [O iii ] / H β \hbox{{\rm[O}\kern 1.00006pt{\sc iii}{\rm]}}/\hbox{{\rm H}$\beta$} vs.

arxiv-2112-07502.title: New charged Higgs boson discovery channel at the LHC
arxiv-2112-07502.creator: R. Benbrik, M. Boukidi, B. Manaut, M. Ouchemhou, S. Semlali, and S. Taj
arxiv-2112-07502.description: Abstract The ATLAS and CMS experiments have an ambitious search program for charged Higgs bosons. The two main searches for H ± H^{\pm} at the LHC have traditionally been performed in the τ ​ ν \tau\nu and t ​ b tb decay channels, as they provide the opportunity to probe complementary regions of the Minimal SuperSymmetric Model (MSSM) parameter space.

arxiv-2303-11909.title: The Multiscale Surface Vision Transformer
arxiv-2303-11909.creator: Simon Dahan, Abdulah Fawaz, Mohamed A. Suliman, Mariana da Silva, Logan Z. J. Williams Daniel Rueckert, Emma C. Robinson
arxiv-2303-11909.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Simon Dahan, Abdulah Fawaz, Mohamed A. Suliman, Mariana da Silva, Logan Z. J. Williams Daniel Rueckert, Emma C. Robinson. Surface meshes are a favoured domain for representing structural and functional information on the human cortex, but their complex topology and geometry pose significant challenges for deep learning analysis.

arxiv-2305-18328.title: Open-Source GEMM Hardware Kernels Generator: Toward Numerically-Tailored Computations
arxiv-2305-18328.creator: Louis Ledoux 1 2 , Marc Casas 1 2
arxiv-2305-18328.description: Abstract E-mail: {louis.ledoux, marc.casas}@bsc.es I Extended Abstract Many scientific computing problems can be reduced to Matrix-Matrix Multiplications (MMM), making the General Matrix Multiply (GEMM) kernels in the Basic Linear Algebra Subroutine (BLAS) of interest to the high-performance computing community. However, these workloads have a wide range of numerical requirements.

arxiv-2306-06845.title: Information-Theoretic Limits and Strong Consistency on Binary Non-uniform Hypergraph Stochastic Block Models
arxiv-2306-06845.creator: Hai-Xiao Wang
arxiv-2306-06845.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hai-Xiao Wang. Consider the unsupervised classification problem in random hypergraphs under the non-uniform Hypergraph Stochastic Block Model (HSBM) with two equal-sized communities, where each edge appears independently with some probability depending only on the labels of its vertices. In this paper, the information-theoretic limits on the clustering accuracy and the strong consistency threshold are established, expressed in terms of the generalized Hellinger distance.

arxiv-2406-14302.title: Identifiable Exchangeable Mechanisms for Causal Structure and Representation Learning
arxiv-2406-14302.creator: Patrik Reizinger, Siyuan Guo ∗, Ferenc Huszár, Bernhard Schölkopf, Wieland Brendel †
arxiv-2406-14302.description: Abstract Identifying latent representations or causal structures is important for good generalization and downstream task performance. However, both fields developed rather independently. We observe that several structure and representation identifiability methods, particularly those that require multiple environments, rely on exchangeable non–i.i.d. (independent and identically distributed) data.

arxiv-2407-06542.title: Lion s: An Empirically Optimized Approach to Align Language Models
arxiv-2407-06542.creator: Xiao Yu, Qingyang Wu, Yu Li, Zhou YuColumbia University {xy2437, qw2345, yl5016, zy2461}@columbia.edu
arxiv-2407-06542.description: Abstract Alignment is a crucial step to enhance the instruction-following and conversational abilities of language models. Despite many recent work proposing new algorithms, datasets, and training pipelines, there is a lack of comprehensive studies measuring the impact of various design choices throughout the whole training process.

arxiv-2502-03758.title: Improving Adversarial Robustness via Phase and Amplitude-aware Prompting
arxiv-2502-03758.creator: Yibo Xu, Dawei Zhou, Decheng Liu, Nannan Wang
arxiv-2502-03758.description: Abstract Deep neural networks are found to be vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. The prompt-based defense has been increasingly studied due to its high efficiency. However, existing prompt-based defenses mainly exploited mixed prompt patterns, where critical patterns closely related to object semantics lack sufficient focus.

arxiv-2503-07870.title: Personalized Code Readability Assessment: Are We There Yet?
arxiv-2503-07870.creator: Antonio Vitale 1 2 , Emanuela Guglielmi 1 , Rocco Oliveto 1 , and Simone Scalabrino 1
arxiv-2503-07870.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Antonio Vitale 1 2 , Emanuela Guglielmi 1 , Rocco Oliveto 1 , and Simone Scalabrino 1. Unreadable code could be a breeding ground for errors. Thus, previous work defined approaches based on machine learning to automatically assess code readability that can warn developers when some code artifacts ( e.g., classes) become unreadable.

arxiv-2509-04257.title: Integrability and lattice discretizations of all Topological Defect Lines in minimal CFTs
arxiv-2509-04257.creator: Madhav Sinha, Thiago Silva Tavares, Ananda Roy, and Hubert Saleur
arxiv-2509-04257.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Madhav Sinha, Thiago Silva Tavares, Ananda Roy, and Hubert Saleur. We discuss in this paper the lattice discretizations of all topological defect lines (TDLs) for diagonal, minimal CFTs, using integrable restricted solid-on-solid (RSOS) models. For these CFTs, the TDLs can be labeled by the Kac labels.

arxiv-2512-23957.title: Concentration and fluctuations of sine–Gordon measure around topological multi-soliton manifold
arxiv-2512-23957.creator: Kihoon Seong, Hao Shen, and Philippe Sosoe
arxiv-2512-23957.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kihoon Seong, Hao Shen, and Philippe Sosoe. We study the sine–Gordon measure defined on each homotopy class. The energy space decomposes into infinitely many such classes indexed by the topological degree Q ∈ ℤ Q\in\mathbb{Z} . Even though the sine–Gordon action admits no minimizer in homotopy classes with | Q | ≥ 2 |Q|\geq 2 , we prove that the Gibbs measure on each class nevertheless concentrates and exhibits Ornstein–Uhlenbeck fluctuations near the multi-soliton manifold in the joint low-temperature and infinite-volume limit.

pmc-10680116.title: WHO air quality database: relevance, history and future developments
pmc-10680116.creator: Kerolyn Shairsingh, Giulia Ruggeri, Michal Krzyzanowski, Pierpaolo Mudu, Mazen Malkawi, Juan Castillo, Agnes Soares da Silva, Manjeet Saluja, Karla Cervantes Martínez, Josselyn Mothe, Sophie Gumy
pmc-10680116.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Air pollution is the second most important risk factor for noncommunicable diseases, but air quality monitoring is lacking in many low- and middle-income countries. The World Health Organization (WHO) recently released its 2022 updated air quality database status report. This report contains data from about 6743 human settlements, a sixfold increase from 1102 settlements in its first publication in 2011, which shows that air pollution is increasingly recognized as a health priority at global and national levels.

pmc-11360743.title: Advancing medical laboratory practice in Pakistan: insights from a focus group study on technologists’ training needs
pmc-11360743.creator: Fatima Muhammad Asad Khan, Bushra Moiz, Javeria Rehman, Hafsa Majid, Mohammad Zeeshan, Lena Jafri, Aysha Habib Khan
pmc-11360743.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe realm of medical laboratory technology (MLT) training and education is unstructured in Pakistan. The primary challenge currently confronting the workforce in MLT is the absence of standardized curricula and assessments in education and training.

pmc-11511330.title: Mobile Application Development for Prepaid Water Meter Based on LC Sensor
pmc-11511330.creator: Ario Kusuma Purboyo, Hanif Fakhrurroja, Dita Pramesti, Achmad Rozan Chaidir
pmc-11511330.description: This study presents a novel low-cost and low-power prepaid water meter system that combines tokenization and LC sensors to monitor water consumption accurately with mobile application via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connectivity compared to conventional meters. Water meters play a vital role in monitoring water usage in Indonesia.

pmc-11583874.title: Bioaerosols and Airborne Transmission in the Dental Clinic
pmc-11583874.creator: James R Allison, Stefanie Tiede, Richard Holliday, Justin Durham, Nicholas S Jakubovics
pmc-11583874.description: The importance of aerosols (particles suspended in air) produced during dental procedures became more apparent than ever during the COVID-19 pandemic. Concerns over transmission of infection in these aerosols led to unprecedented disruption to dental services across the world, adversely impacting patients’ oral health.

pmc-11614453.title: Evaluating diurnal rhythms of host responses to enteric norovirus infection in mouse models
pmc-11614453.creator: Jianglin Zhang, Robert C Orchard, Zheng Kuang
pmc-11614453.description: Norovirus is a leading cause of gastroenteritis worldwide. The factors required for the life cycle and pathogenesis of norovirus in humans remain unclear. Mouse models of norovirus infection have been widely used to explore the crosstalk between norovirus and the host. The circadian clock entrains biological processes and behaviors including eating and sleeping in response to day–night cycles.

pmc-11636383.title: Genome sequences of Microvirga spp. CF3062 and CF3016 isolated from nodules found on herbarium specimens collected in 2004 and 2015
pmc-11636383.creator: Renee H. Petipas, Hanna Kehlet-Delgado, Amanda A. Antoch, Maren L. Friesen
pmc-11636383.description: We present the genomes of two Microvirga isolates isolated from nodules found on Medicago lupulina herbarium specimens at the Marion Ownbey Herbarium at Washington State University. These genomes and others from herbarium specimens offer an unprecedented opportunity to study the bacterial evolution of plant-associated microbes over long time scales. ANNOUNCEMENT Microvirga spp.

pmc-12422794.title: Age-related diseases as a testbed for anti-aging therapeutics: the case of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-12422794.creator: Alex Zhavoronkov, Dominika Wilczok, Feng Ren, Fedor Galkin
pmc-12422794.description: While aging-related diseases are often used as proxies for the general aging process in research, they largely differ in terms of how integral their development is to organismal aging. Hallmarks of aging offer a convenient conceptual framework to assess the relevance of a disease to the anti-aging narrative.

pmc-12619332.title: Characteristics of cohort data management systems (CDMS): a scoping review
pmc-12619332.creator: Arezoo Abasi, Haleh Ayatollahi, Seyed Abbas Motevalian
pmc-12619332.description: Cohort studies are a core aspect of clinical research which helps to gather a large volume of data over time. As digital technologies evolve, managing these data has become increasingly complex. Therefore, the use of cohort data management systems (CDMS) has been suggested to enhance data accuracy, confidentiality, and consistency.

pmc-12784935.title: Detection of Expressed Otx mRNA Isoforms in Sea Urchins by Mapping NGS Reads to Single-Gene/Transcript Sequences
pmc-12784935.creator: Mariia A. Maiorova, Yulia O. Kipryushina, Konstantin V. Yakovlev
pmc-12784935.description: Simple SummaryDetermination of mRNA isoform expression is important for studying tissue-specific gene regulation and the generation of protein diversity. We tested the potential of mapping to a single-gene/transcript for the qualitative examination of mRNA isoform expression produced from the same gene, including cases where several mRNA species are expressed in samples.

pmc-12914499.title: ‘Nurses’ Assessment and Perception of Live Music in the Intensive Care Unit: A Convergent Mixed‐Methods Study
pmc-12914499.creator: Linette Thorn, Anna Holm, Trine Højfeldt Lund, Margrethe Langer Bro, Pia Dreyer
pmc-12914499.description: BackgroundLive music interventions in hospital settings have been shown to alleviate anxiety, reduce pain and enhance patient well‐being—not only for patients but also for healthcare professionals working in high‐stress environments such as intensive care units (ICUs). However, limited research has explored ICU nurses' experiences of live music.

pmc-13271911.title: High-frequency oscillations and sleep spindles in epilepsy: from mechanisms to modeling
pmc-13271911.creator: Kairan Zhao, Mengmeng Wu, Jun Zhao, Yiliang Teng, Zhen Sun, Yanping Sun
pmc-13271911.description: High-frequency oscillations (HFOs) and sleep spindles are key neural rhythms in non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep with significance for information processing and epilepsy research. This review summarizes the neurophysiological basis of HFOs and spindles, with emphasis on cross-frequency coupling and its pathological alterations in epilepsy.

pmc-13429475.title: Interpretable machine learning for presurgical differentiation of Hürthle cell carcinoma and adenoma: a SHAP-augmented approach
pmc-13429475.creator: Junyu Cao, Jing Li, Chuancheng Zhou, Jie Zhou, Kunxian Yang
pmc-13429475.description: BackgroundThe preoperative differentiation between benign Hürthle cell adenoma (HCA) and malignant Hürthle cell carcinoma (HCC) remains clinically challenging. This study aimed to develop an interpretable machine learning framework to improve diagnostic accuracy and assist clinical decision-making.MethodsWe retrospectively enrolled 554 patients (280 HCA, 274 HCC) from a single center. Fifteen clinical, serological, and ultrasonographic variables were incorporated.

pmc-13538733.title: Real‐World Use of Semaglutide for Weight Management: Dose Titration, Discontinuation Patterns and Weight Changes
pmc-13538733.creator: Mie Dyberg Skandov, Katrine McLain Christensen, Dagmar Abelone Dalin, Janne Unkerskov, Andreas Brønden, Marie Lund, Mikkel Bring Christensen, Kristian Karstoft
pmc-13538733.description: AimIn December 2022, semaglutide injections for weight management were marketed in Denmark. Pre‐marketing trials documented high efficacy when adherence to the treatment and the recommended dose titration schedule was followed. This study aimed to describe real‐world use of semaglutide, including dose titration, discontinuation patterns and effectiveness on body weight in adults with overweight or obesity treated in primary care.

pmc-13547168.title: Diversion proctitis during staged restorative proctocolectomy with ileal pouch anal anastomosis is not associated with subsequent cuffitis

pmc-13714225.creator: Robin Chang, Alejandro S Mendoza, Swikrity U Baskota
pmc-13714225.description: Combined small cell lung carcinoma (SCLC) is not uncommon, though the combination with a second primary adenocarcinoma is less frequent. Molecular profiling can clarify clonal relationships and identify potentially actionable alterations, but interpretation requires careful integration with histologic and clinical findings.
